description.value:
There is a thirteenth sky, and on the nights it shows there is no constellation in it at all. Every other Saint stands in the dark. You do not.

On any day the sky is Starless — no sign ascendant — your own constellation is treated as ascendant instead, and you gain your Ascendant Boon for the whole day.

You also always know when a Starless sky is coming, one day in advance.

Design note: this feat is listed in the class guide's feat table but was never written up. The rules here are a first pass from its one-line description and are the most likely thing in this module to want a second look.
